title: agent-status/1
description: One small JSON file that says what one AI agent, task, job or project is doing right now. Readers accept any agent-status/1.x file and ignore fields they do not know; extensions use keys that start with x-.

spec.description: Standard and version. Writers put agent-status/1; readers accept agent-status/1 and any agent-status/1.x.

id.description: Stable identifier, also the file name (<id>.json). Letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore; starts with a letter or digit.

title.description: Short human name for the agent or task.

state.description: ok = fine or finished; waiting = needs a person; working = running now; error = failed.

updated.description: When this file was last written: RFC 3339 date-time with an offset.

kind.description: What this file describes. Default task.

agent.description: Which tool or provider writes this file, for example claude-code, codex, gemini-cli, cursor, cron.

message.description: One line about what is happening now.

needs_you.description: Things a person must do. An empty list or no key means nothing.

progress.description: Steps done out of total. done must not be larger than total.

stale_after.description: Seconds after updated when a working file reads as error (stopped responding). 0 or null: never. Readers default to 1800.

started.description: When the current run or session started.

next_run.description: For kind job: when the next run is due.

links.description: Related links. Only https, http and file links.

^x-.description: Extension fields. Readers ignore the ones they do not know.
